## Case studies
- [Amazon India Analytics Dashboard](https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/work/amazon-analytics/): seven-page Amazon advertising analytics platform tracking ACOS, ROAS, CPC and ad spend across 18 ASINs and 3,500+ keywords. Puppeteer Stealth auto-fetches weekly. Built on Node.js + PostgreSQL.
- [Finance dashboards (4 projects)](https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/work/finance-dashboards/): React + Node + PostgreSQL dashboards across P&L, AR aging, reconciliation, and expense automation. Cut weekly reporting time by 70%.
- [NeoMail — Email client](https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/work/neomail/): full-stack MERN email client with JWT HTTP-only cookie auth, MongoDB TTL auto-expiry, Redux Toolkit state. Live demo on Vercel.

## Selected engineering writeups
- [Amazon Ads dashboard with Puppeteer + Postgres](https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/blog/amazon-analytics-puppeteer-postgres.html): the architecture and schema decisions that cut weekly Amazon advertising reporting from 4 hours to 5 minutes
- [4 finance dashboards in 9 months — React + Node playbook](https://gaurav-portfolio-g1ks.vercel.app/blog/finance-dashboards-playbook.html): five patterns that repeat across every finance dashboard — denormalised reporting views, freshness badge, server aggregation, CSV export, audit log
